# Seed fixtures (generated: do not edit by hand)

Generated by `python -m app.ingestion.mock_seeder --target memory` from `backend/`.
Every score, hash distance and reason here was computed by the real Halisi engine
(`score_against_all`) on the fictional seed set in `backend/app/ingestion/mock_seeder.py`.
Re-run the seeder instead of editing these files. All businesses, handles and numbers are fictional.
Clock: fixed at $seed_now so the files are reproducible (`elapsed_ms` is measured and may change).

Shapes follow docs/BACKEND.md section 5 exactly (same serializers as the API).

| File | Endpoint / shape |
| :-- | :-- |
| `checks.json` | Index: key, file, scan_id, handle, platform, url, verdict, score, kind (blatant/subtle/competitor/official), merchant_slug |
| `check-<key>.json` | `POST /api/v1/check` and `GET /api/v1/check/{scan_id}` -> `CheckResult` (public: third-party numbers masked). Keys: `<merchant>_blatant`, `<merchant>_subtle`, `<merchant>_competitor`, `<merchant>_official` for nsv / kg / pt |
| `merchant-<slug>.json` | `GET /api/v1/merchants/{slug}` -> public profile |
| `threats-<slug>.json` | `GET /api/v1/merchants/{id}/threats` -> `ThreatSummary[]` (score desc) |
| `threat-<threat_id>.json` | `GET /api/v1/threats/{id}` -> `ThreatDetail` (key-protected: unmasked numbers) |
| `playbooks-<threat_id>-<en/sw>.json` | `POST /api/v1/threats/{id}/playbooks?lang=` -> template playbooks (offline path) |
| `alerts-<slug>.json` | `GET /api/v1/merchants/{id}/alerts` -> `{alerts, unread_count, server_time}` |
| `stats.json` | `GET /api/v1/stats` (global) |
| `stats-<slug>.json` | `GET /api/v1/stats?merchant_id=` with the key (adds active_threats, resolved, customers_warned_estimate) |
| `verify-payment.json` | `GET /api/v1/verify/payment?value=<key>` -> response, keyed by the queried value |
| `assets/*.png` | Logos (`<merchant>_logo.png`) and avatars (`<target key>.png`). JSON refers to them as `/seed/<file>`: copy this folder to `frontend/public/seed/` (the backend also serves them at `<API>/seed/`). |

Files: $count JSON files plus assets.
